subject: FinBank buy-flow & advocate kit
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.o@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@finbank.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: FinBank buy-flow & advocate kit

Lindsey — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Demo highlights / fit: Redwood meets the 200ms p99 latency target for the workloads you showed; we have a VPC/private option for regulated data and an audit trail for access.
- Primary decision criteria you called out: economics (TCO vs. self-host), security (SOC2 / encryption / logging), deployment flexibility, and predictable SLA.
- Stakeholders to engage: econ buyer (Jordan Meyers), procurement, and security (Priya Suri). You mentioned a short procurement window in July — perfect.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You introduce Jordan + Priya to our team (email thread) so we can map procurement questions and legal asks.
2) We’ll produce a 1-page Champion Deck + an ROI one-pager Lindsey can use internally (see attached Advocate_Kit_Grace_v1.pdf and ROI_onepager.xlsx).
3) Connor will prepare a tailored cost model and deployment options matrix for FinBank.
4) Schedule a 30-min procurement/tech sync with procurement + engineering — we suggested the week of Jul 6.

Can you please confirm who will be the formal procurement contact and whether we should route the SOC2 / security questionnaire to Priya or a shared mailbox (procurement@finbank.com)? If you can loop them in on this thread that would be ideal.

Attachments: Advocate_Kit_Grace_v1.pdf (1.1MB) — one-pager + talk tracks; ROI_onepager.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — I’ll follow up to share the champion-facing language and a short email template Lindsey can forward.

— Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.o@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@finbank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.o@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@finbank.com>, Priya Suri <priya.suri@finbank.com>, procurement@finbank.com
Date: 2026-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinBank buy-flow & advocate kit

Grace — appreciate the tidy recap. Confirming roles on our side: 
- Jordan Meyers (cc'd) is our economic buyer / head of procurement — he owns budget and vendor evaluations.
- Priya Suri (cc'd) is our CISO; she'll lead the security questionnaire and needs SOC2 + logging architecture detail.
- procurement@finbank.com is the formal procurement mailbox for PO / SOW coordination.

Procurement timeline: ideally a decision by end of July. Our internal ask list for Redwood before procurement can move: a) tailored cost estimate for our expected usage (Q3 forward), b) completed security questionnaire (I'll attach our RFI), c) a 1-page exec brief for Jordan that highlights TCO and risk mitigation.

I attached our RFI (FinBank_RFI.docx) — please have the security and product folks review sections 2–4; Jordan will want the executive summary and run-rate implications. Also, a short bullet list of 'what success looks like' for our econ buyer would help (cost/latency/regulatory coverage).

If you can send the champion deck and a short note Jordan can forward to his finance committee that would speed things up. Happy to schedule the procurement sync after you share the cost estimate.

Best,
Lindsey Park
Senior Product Manager (AI) — FinBank
lindsey.park@finbank.com

Attachment: FinBank_RFI.docx (stub)

- A short cost model (CSV) for the FinBank baseline usage Lindsey mentioned in the call (10k prompts/day, mixed gen/embedding traffic), including hosted vs dedicated vs private pricing buckets.
- A deployment options matrix (latency, security guarantees, expected unit cost).

Evelyn — we'll likely need a quick SLA/contract fallback note (what's negotiable for critical SLAs, sample credit language). Can you line up a legal touchpoint to review after Connor's cost model is ready?

I'll draft the one-page champion deck and a two-sentence talk track Lindsey can forward to Jordan. Goal: hand Lindsey something tomorrow EOD to keep the procurement window in July.

Grace / Evelyn — I can take point on the cost model. Deliverables and timeline from me: 

- Redwood_cost_model_FinBank.csv (attached) — baseline + hosted vs dedicated vs private scenarios, with monthly run-rates and tokens-per-month assumptions.
- Short note for Jordan (two bullets) that highlights 12-month TCO and expected break-even vs self-host (we'll flag non-recurring infra effort).
- Proposed agenda for procurement/tech sync (30 mins): 1) Exec summary (Jordan), 2) Security Qs (Priya), 3) Deployment & support SLAs (Evelyn), 4) Next steps and purchasing options.

I reviewed the RFI and noted three security items to escalate to product/security: encryption-at-rest key management details, audit log retention periods, and on-prem connectivity options for air-gapped lanes. Priya — if you want, Connor and I can join a 20-min pre-sync to walk through these.

Next steps: I'll finalize the CSV and the two-bullet executive note by tomorrow 11:00am PT. Grace — once you have the champion deck, we can send a single bundle to Lindsey for Jordan.
